statement:
∀ (ε : ℝ),
  0 < ε →
    have g := fun x => rexp (-x ^ 2 / ε ^ 2) / (ε * √π);
    ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv g x * x = -1 ∧
      ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv g x * x ^ 2 = 0 ∧
        ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv g x * rexp x = -rexp (ε ^ 2 / 4) ∧
          ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv (deriv g) x * x ^ 2 = 2 ∧
            ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv (deriv g) x * cos x = -rexp (-ε ^ 2 / 4) ∧
              ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv g x * sin x = -rexp (-ε ^ 2 / 4)

goal.text:
have g := fun x => rexp (-x ^ 2 / ε ^ 2) / (ε * √π);
∫ (x : ℝ), deriv g x * x = -1 ∧
  ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv g x * x ^ 2 = 0 ∧
    ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv g x * rexp x = -rexp (ε ^ 2 / 4) ∧
      ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv (deriv g) x * x ^ 2 = 2 ∧
        ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv (deriv g) x * cos x = -rexp (-ε ^ 2 / 4) ∧ ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv g x * sin x = -rexp (-ε ^ 2 / 4)
